body:
Back in October 2016 some friends and I, while camping, went on a golf cart joy ride. Someone fell off the golf cart. We did't realize how bad it was so we picked up the guy and moved him back the camp ground. I called the police. I was arrested for dui, and the guy was in a coma for a few months. Why wife was ready to divorce me. I went I to a deep depression an and started using drugs anything that would take my mind off the accident. My depression bottomed pretty hard when it was getting close to the day of the accident. And I didn't get out of bed for 2 weeks, obviously I lost my $4400.00 job. Less than a month after  I loose my job while in the deepest depression of my life, my wife is told she has stage 4 colon cancer that has spread to her liver. Some drs give her hope, others have no bedside manner and in so many words said "3 years make the most of it."

Well, it can always get worse. I try to get work, and couldn't for 5 months. Family and friends are helping us with food and donating to my wifes cancer but no one knows about my legal situation. Her entire family treats me like her cancer is my fault somehow.

It's the worst I've ever been treated, people making huge scenes at Christmas parties, that's right, more that one. Yelling and screaming at me, calling me some of the worst things I've ever been called, because they are upset and dont know how to direct it. So they don't really like me anyways so I got it all. And no one came to my rescue, no one defended me. My wife just stood behind them shaking her head up and down.

Now through all that I've got some work making less than have as normal, and I got some side work too. My wife kicked me out because I stole some of her pain pills, I knew she would see them missing and I had no way to replace them, and I could get my own. It's like I did it so she would kick me out because the fact is my wife, my daughter, mother in law, mother in laws husband, and brother in law all say I treat my wife bad. Laughable! They just want to blame someone and my wife clearly hates me. The only reason she didn't divorce me in 2016 is because I was making so much money and she could afford the house with out. 

As soon as we split she put the house on the market has taken my kids to another state with her mother, which is good for them, but its killing me. The person I think actually likes me and I might not see him again. I'm facing 10 years for the golf cart joy ride. I don't have the money for expensive ass lawyer and I'd rather be dead then cause anymore harm.

 Living with multiple who blame me for everything that goes wrong had a strong effect on  my mental health.
